steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Definition: Grouped data organises values into class intervals. When class intervals have different widths, we need special techniques to represent them fairly. | Higher Tier Only: Histograms with unequal class intervals and cumulative frequency graphs are Higher tier topics. You must understand frequency density.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: A histogram bar has width 25 and frequency density 3.2. Find the frequency. | Calculate the frequency density for a class with width 15 and frequency 45. | A cumulative frequency graph has total 200. What cumulative frequency gives the median?

steps.title: Lesson 4: Exam Practice
steps.body: Extended Answer 6 marks: A histogram shows the times taken for 200 runners to complete a race. One bar covers 20–30 minutes with frequency density 4. Another bar covers 30–50 minutes with frequency density 3. (a) Find the frequency for each class. (b) A third class 50–60 minutes has frequency 20. Find its frequency density.
